use_MetricLogger: create a MetricLogger to log training metrics to a JSONL file with optional WandB integration
use_GPUMemoryMonitor: create a GPUMemoryMonitor to track GPU memory usage and get peak stats for a CUDA device
use_upload_train_to_wandb: upload training and evaluation metrics from a checkpoint directory to a WandB project
use_get_num_params: get the total number of parameters in a PyTorch model module
use_log_model_params: log the frozen and trainable parameter counts of a PyTorch model to the logger
